Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 14
, Reason for Mistake: In Step 14, the Planner incorrectly interpreted the IMDb release data for *Gaza Ghetto*. The visible text clearly lists "Denmark January 22, 1988", but the Planner's analysis erroneously claimed this date was "Jan 22, 1998". This hallucination of a year digit (changing 1988 to 1998) led to the incorrect conclusion that *Gaza Ghetto* was released more recently than *Kull The Conqueror* (1997), when in fact the Danish release was still in 1988.
